parameters.query:
-- 9b: Station 1 equipment lookup by ID (deterministic, no LLM). Always returns one row: the machine's columns,
-- or NULLs when there is no ID or no match. For chat runs it also writes the Station 1 trace step.
-- $1 = equipment_id (or 'NO-ID'), $2 = run_id ('' for sensor alerts), $3 = parsed intent JSON
WITH p AS (
  SELECT $1::text AS eid, as_uuid($2) AS rid, $3::jsonb AS intent,
         round(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint AS now_ms
),
e AS (SELECT * FROM equipment WHERE equipment_id = (SELECT eid FROM p)),
t AS (
  SELECT trace_add_steps(p.rid, jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
    'station', 'Station 1',
    'step', 'check_alert -> Understand: ' || coalesce((SELECT name || ' (' || equipment_id || ')' FROM e), 'no machine')
            || coalesce(', ' || (p.intent->>'sensor_type') || ' ' || coalesce(p.intent->>'sensor_value', ''), ''),
    'detail', jsonb_build_object(
      'tool', 'check_alert',
      'args', jsonb_build_object('query', p.intent->>'raw_query', 'equipment_id', p.intent->>'equipment_id'),
      'parsed', p.intent - 'raw_query' - 'started_at' - 'run_id',
      'db_lookup', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('equipment_id', equipment_id, 'name', name, 'site', site, 'line', line,
                                              'max_temp_c', max_temp_c, 'max_vibration_mm_s', max_vibration_mm_s) FROM e)),
    'ms', p.now_ms - (p.intent->>'started_at')::bigint))) AS traced
  FROM p
)
SELECT e.*, p.now_ms AS t_station1
FROM p CROSS JOIN t LEFT JOIN e ON true;

parameters.query:
-- 18a: log every alert; update the machine's status when it was identified.
-- ACT -> fault, HOLD -> explained, ESCALATE -> watch. A later reading always replaces the status (that is how faults clear).
-- For chat runs (run_id set) it also writes the Station 4 and Write-back trace steps.
WITH p AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j, round(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint AS now_ms),
r AS (SELECT as_uuid(j->>'run_id') AS rid FROM p),
eq AS (SELECT e.equipment_id FROM equipment e, p WHERE e.equipment_id = p.j->>'equipment_id'),
old AS (SELECT s.status FROM equipment_status s WHERE s.equipment_id = (SELECT equipment_id FROM eq)),
log AS (
  INSERT INTO alert_log (equipment_id, input_source, summary, decision, confidence, reason, run_id)
  SELECT (SELECT equipment_id FROM eq), j->>'source', j->>'query', j->>'action', (j->>'confidence_score')::int, j->>'explanation', (SELECT rid FROM r) FROM p
  RETURNING id
),
up AS (
  INSERT INTO equipment_status (equipment_id, status, reason, last_reading, updated_at)
  SELECT eq.equipment_id,
         CASE p.j->>'action' WHEN 'ACT' THEN 'fault' WHEN 'HOLD' THEN 'explained' ELSE 'watch' END,
         p.j->>'explanation',
         jsonb_build_object('query', p.j->>'query', 'sensor_type', p.j->>'sensor_type', 'sensor_value', p.j->'sensor_value',
                            'confidence', p.j->'confidence_score', 'alert_id', (SELECT id FROM log), 'at', now()),
         now()
  FROM p, eq
  ON CONFLICT (equipment_id) DO UPDATE
    SET status = EXCLUDED.status, reason = EXCLUDED.reason, last_reading = EXCLUDED.last_reading, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
  RETURNING equipment_id, status
),
t AS (
  SELECT trace_add_steps((SELECT rid FROM r), jsonb_build_array(
    jsonb_build_object('station', 'Station 4',
      'step', 'Decide -> ' || (p.j->>'action') || ' (' || (p.j->>'confidence_score') || '%), ' || CASE WHEN p.j->>'response_source' = 'template' THEN 'template' ELSE 'LLM' END,
      'detail', jsonb_build_object('decision', p.j->>'action', 'status', p.j->>'status', 'confidence', p.j->'confidence_score',
                                   'answer_by', CASE WHEN p.j->>'response_source' = 'template' THEN 'template (no LLM)' ELSE 'LLM' END,
                                   'model', p.j->>'model', 'explanation', p.j->>'explanation', 'response', p.j->>'response'),
      'ms', p.now_ms - (p.j->>'t14_end')::bigint),
    jsonb_build_object('station', 'Write-back',
      'step', CASE WHEN (SELECT equipment_id FROM eq) IS NULL THEN 'Alert logged (no machine identified)'
                   ELSE (SELECT equipment_id FROM eq) || ': ' || coalesce((SELECT status FROM old), 'none') || ' -> ' || (SELECT status FROM up) END,
      'detail', jsonb_build_object('equipment_id', (SELECT equipment_id FROM eq), 'old_status', (SELECT status FROM old),
                                   'new_status', (SELECT status FROM up), 'alert_log_id', (SELECT id FROM log)),
      'ms', round(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint - p.now_ms)
  )) AS traced FROM p
)
SELECT (SELECT equipment_id FROM up) AS equipment_id, (SELECT status FROM up) AS status, (SELECT id FROM log) AS alert_id, (SELECT traced FROM t) AS traced;

-- Status job (every 15 min). Faults are never changed here: only a later reading or a dashboard reset clears them.
WITH a AS (SELECT unnest($1::text[]) AS id),
start_m AS (
  UPDATE equipment_status s SET status = 'maintenance', reason = 'Scheduled maintenance/cleaning window', updated_at = now()
  WHERE s.equipment_id IN (SELECT id FROM a) AND s.status NOT IN ('fault', 'maintenance')
  RETURNING s.equipment_id, 'to maintenance'::text AS change),
end_m AS (
  UPDATE equipment_status s SET status = 'normal', reason = 'Maintenance window ended', updated_at = now()
  -- only maintenance the schedule set; maintenance marked by a person stays until they mark it normal
  WHERE s.status = 'maintenance' AND s.reason = 'Scheduled maintenance/cleaning window' AND s.equipment_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM a)
  RETURNING s.equipment_id, 'maintenance -> normal'::text),
expired AS (
  UPDATE equipment_status s SET status = 'normal', reason = 'Explained alert expired after 3 hours', updated_at = now()
  WHERE s.status = 'explained' AND s.updated_at < now() - interval '3 hours' AND s.equipment_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM a)
  RETURNING s.equipment_id, 'explained -> normal'::text)
SELECT * FROM start_m UNION ALL SELECT * FROM end_m UNION ALL SELECT * FROM expired;

parameters.initialMessages: Hi! Tell me what you see on a machine, or ask: How are my machines doing?

options.systemMessage:
You are AlgoFactory, the floor assistant for factory managers and maintenance workers. Replies are read on the floor in a few seconds: short, plain words, no jargon. Never invent machines, readings or numbers.

TOOLS
- lookup_equipment: call it FIRST whenever the message mentions a machine or a symptom. Pass the machine words exactly as the worker wrote them (e.g. "Pump 2", "Equipment-001", "compressor on Line 9", "motor").
  - Exactly 1 row: call check_alert with that equipment_id and the worker's message.
  - Several rows: do NOT call check_alert. Ask which one: "Which motor? Motor 1 (Austin, Line 1), Motor 2 (Austin, Line 1), ..." (at most 8, one line).
  - 0 rows: do NOT call check_alert. Say you could not find that machine and ask for its name or ID. Never pick one yourself.
- check_alert: runs the sensor, schedule, baseline and history checks. Use only what it returns.
- get_equipment_status: for questions like "How are my machines doing?" or "What's happening in Austin?". Pass "all", a site, state, region, line or machine. Use total and by_status exactly as returned (never count rows yourself).

LABELS (always uppercase, always first on the line; the dashboard colors them)
- ACT NOW: a real fault (check_alert action ACT, or status fault)
- HOLD: explained, no action needed (check_alert action HOLD, or status explained)
- CHECK: not confirmed, needs a look (check_alert action ESCALATE, or status watch)
- IN MAINTENANCE: status maintenance
- OK: everything normal

REPLY AFTER check_alert (2 lines, nothing else):
<LABEL> · <Machine name> (<site>, <line>) · <confidence_score>%
<What is going on, in plain words>. Next: <one action a floor worker can do now>.

REPLY AFTER get_equipment_status:
Reply with summary_text exactly as returned, word for word. Add nothing before or after it, change nothing, add no percentages or advice.

PLAIN WORDS
- Never show field or code names (max_temp_c, layer, baseline + 15, by_status, needs_attention) or raw formulas like "85 >= 85".
- Say it as a person would: "running at its temperature limit (85°C)", "humidity is high because of this morning's cleaning", "noise reported, no sensor reading yet".
- No zero counts, no lists of every status, no markdown headings or bold.

parameters.description: Run the AlgoFactory checks (evidence, sensors, schedule, baseline, history) for one identified machine. Call only after lookup_equipment returned exactly one row. Returns action (ACT/HOLD/ESCALATE), confidence_score, explanation and response.

parameters.query:
SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r ORDER BY r.site, r.line, r.name), '[]') AS equipment
FROM (
  SELECT e.equipment_id, e.name, e.type, e.site, e.state, e.region, e.line, e.location,
         e.max_temp_c, e.max_vibration_mm_s, e.bearing_type,
         s.status, s.reason, s.last_reading, s.updated_at,
         (SELECT count(*) FROM alert_log a
           WHERE a.equipment_id = e.equipment_id
             AND (a.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')::date)::int AS alerts_today
  FROM equipment e JOIN equipment_status s USING (equipment_id)
) r;

WITH d AS (SELECT CASE WHEN $1 = 'today' THEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')::date ELSE $1::date END AS day)
SELECT (SELECT day FROM d)::text AS date, coalesce(json_agg(r ORDER BY r.created_at DESC), '[]') AS alerts
FROM (
  SELECT a.id, a.created_at, a.equipment_id, e.name, e.site, e.line, a.input_source, a.summary,
         a.decision, a.confidence, a.reason
  FROM alert_log a LEFT JOIN equipment e USING (equipment_id), d
  WHERE (a.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')::date = d.day
) r;

SELECT e.equipment_id, e.name, e.type, e.site, e.line, e.location, e.max_temp_c, e.max_vibration_mm_s,
       s.status, s.reason, s.last_reading, s.updated_at, $2::int AS hours,
       coalesce((SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.created_at DESC) FROM (
          SELECT id, created_at, input_source, summary, decision, confidence, reason, action_note, performed_by
          FROM alert_log WHERE equipment_id = $1 AND created_at >= now() - make_interval(hours => $2::int)) x), '[]') AS alerts
FROM equipment e JOIN equipment_status s USING (equipment_id)
WHERE e.equipment_id = $1;

WITH v AS (SELECT $1::text AS eid, lower(trim($2)) AS st, nullif(trim($3), '') AS note, nullif(trim($4), '') AS who),
ok AS (
  SELECT v.* FROM v
  WHERE v.st IN ('normal', 'maintenance') AND v.note IS NOT NULL AND v.who IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM equipment e WHERE e.equipment_id = v.eid)
),
old AS (SELECT s.status FROM equipment_status s, ok WHERE s.equipment_id = ok.eid),
u AS (
  UPDATE equipment_status s
  SET status = ok.st, reason = 'Action taken by ' || ok.who || ': ' || ok.note, updated_at = now()
  FROM ok WHERE s.equipment_id = ok.eid
  RETURNING s.equipment_id, s.status
),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO alert_log (equipment_id, input_source, summary, decision, confidence, reason, action_note, performed_by)
  SELECT ok.eid, 'dashboard', 'Action taken: ' || ok.note, 'ACTION', NULL,
         'By ' || ok.who || ' · ' || coalesce((SELECT status FROM old), '?') || ' -> ' || ok.st, ok.note, ok.who
  FROM ok
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS updated, $1 AS equipment_id, (SELECT status FROM old) AS old_status,
       (SELECT status FROM u) AS new_status, (SELECT id FROM l) AS alert_id,
       CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ok)
            THEN 'Not saved: choose Back to normal or In maintenance, describe what was done, and enter your name.' END AS error;

SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.started_at DESC), '[]') AS runs
FROM (
  SELECT r.run_id, r.started_at, r.input, r.status, r.equipment_id, e.name, e.site, r.decision, r.confidence,
         r.llm_calls, r.tool_calls,
         coalesce(r.total_ms, round(extract(epoch FROM now() - r.started_at) * 1000)::int) AS total_ms,
         (r.status = 'running' AND r.started_at < now() - interval '2 minutes') AS stalled
  FROM runs r LEFT JOIN equipment e USING (equipment_id)
  WHERE ($2 = '' OR e.site = $2 OR lower(split_part(e.site, ' ', 1)) = lower($2))
    AND ($3 = '' OR r.decision = upper($3))
  ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
  LIMIT least(greatest($1::int, 1), 200)
) x;

SELECT r.run_id, r.started_at, r.finished_at, r.input, r.status, r.equipment_id, e.name, e.site, r.decision, r.confidence,
       r.llm_calls, r.tool_calls, r.reply,
       coalesce(r.total_ms, round(extract(epoch FROM now() - r.started_at) * 1000)::int) AS total_ms,
       (r.status = 'running' AND r.started_at < now() - interval '2 minutes') AS stalled,
       coalesce((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('step_no', t.step_no, 'station', t.station, 'step', t.step, 'detail', t.detail,
                                                   'ms', t.ms, 'created_at', t.created_at) ORDER BY t.step_no)
                 FROM run_trace t WHERE t.run_id = r.run_id), '[]') AS steps
FROM runs r LEFT JOIN equipment e USING (equipment_id)
WHERE r.run_id = as_uuid($1);
